name: Ugajin Miyo
source:
One of the heroine's best friends, soft-spoken Miyo is the source of information, having essentially the same role as Tsukushi and Yuu from the [url=http://vndb.org/v857]1st[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/v858]2nd[/url] Girl's Side games. She believes strongly in horoscopes and fortune-telling. Despite her cute appearance, Miyo hates being treated like a child.

[from [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/TokimekiMemorialGirlsSide3]TVTropes[/url]]
